title: Sticker
look: A thick white border and a hard shadow, like a die-cut sticker on a dotted page.

doc.essence: A vinyl sticker: bright flat colours inside a fat white die-cut border, lifted off the page by a hard shadow.
doc.notIt: Not ink (the border is white and fat, not a black line).
doc.shapes: The white border is the outline pass; the shadow is an offset copy of the silhouette.
doc.colour: Saturated +15 %. Page: pale lilac with a dot pattern.
pitfalls: A white mascot loses its edge on the white border: give it a palette tweak.
